Language EN + 11 More Size 209.1 MB iPhone, iPad Remote control for intelligent buildings and smart devices that use Siemens Climatix PLCs. Have your building under control! Inthouse gives you all the power to manage and monitor your smart building and devices, locally and securely over cloud. Supports all devices controlled by Siemens Climatix PLCs. Your unique configuration ID / QR code is printed on your smart device. more Ratings & Reviews This app hasnât received enough ratings or reviews to display an overview. Whatâs New Version History New features: - Now available also on Apple silicon Macs with macOS 15+ - Significantly improved refresh speed of visible values and new alarms - Improved automatic connection switching between local and cloud - Half size button height - Bit Field: option to show different passive labels, short labels, hide certain bits - Bit Field: custom state delimiter, custom label if no state is selected - Bit Field: individual bits can be used in dynamic visibility rules - Reset alarms renamed to Acknowledge alarms, option to display as a list item - Option to hide floating screen back button and close button on some screens - Option to hide schedulers dropdown - Support for placeholders in translations 3.5.2 Apr 1 Fixes: - Trends widget nearest point selection 3.4.3 11/02/2023 New features: - PDF widget - Alarms widget - Favorites widget - Links widget - Clock widget sync PLC time with mobile device time - Trends widget shows current alarms, in chart and as a popup - Trends widget shows enumeration and binary trends, color
